Expected participation, compound-wealth/education benefits, prompt implementation, fairness, cost-covering policy and requests to abolish the ban or alter cross-references are normative or prospective. Their specific current design, fee and cost-incidence premises are separately inventoried.

Proposed eID/BundID/EUDI and digital custody proofs, one-parent-consent exception, process savings and deletion of a step are recommendations/forecasts. Current representation and data-processing premises are retained.

Age-group broadening, private manager choice and altersgerecht wording are recommendations, not descriptions of current rights. The current cohort and manager rules are retained. The §15 editorial-location complaint is assessed as an interpretive premise.

Complete recalculation and IT-provider consultation are policy requests. The zero digital-process model entry and asserted actual understatement are separately assessed; no realised future implementation cost is fabricated.
Cover, contents and contact/registration metadata only.

Three-pillar future need, participation, wealth, finance-education and greater-return benefits are forecasts or evaluations; the conditional compounding and concrete product/fallback design are retained.

Prompt implementation, avoidance of delays, synergies, relative implementation speed and desired institutional structure are prospective judgments. The stated current absence of a specified vehicle is retained as unresolved.

Necessity/appropriateness of fees, unique advantages, optimal safety component and future above-average customer returns are policy judgments or forecasts. Present structural, legal, risk-return and geographic assertions are separately inventoried; costs-must-be-covered is economic framing, not a measured universal pricing result.

Broader locks on own contributions, automatic nullity, central finance terminology and consumer testing are requested changes. Existing draft restrictions, absence of an automatic rule and information topics are retained.

Later availability of entitlement data, extension of the tax-ID route, higher recovery threshold and hardship protection are forecasts/preferences. The existing legal mechanics and existing negative-return rationale are checked separately.
